format.title: Model Format
format.description: Format of the source model: auto takes it from the Model kind or the file extension; onnx or tflite set it.

ir_model.title: Relax IR Model
ir_model.description: Key of the tvm-ir Model written by tvm+build and compiled by tvm+compile. Leave it empty.

model.title: Source Model
model.description: The ONNX or TFLite model to convert: the store:// key of a Model, or an s3:// or https:// path.

so_model.description: Key of the tvm-so Model written by tvm+compile and deployed by tvm+serve. Leave it empty.
